Name: Roses Unofficial Cornucopia - Artisan Machines Vanilla Tweaks Texture pack
Author: Roseloves109
Description:
[b]A Vanilla Tweaks Stylepack for Cornucopia - Artisan Machines!
[/b]This mod replaces the original textures for 53 artisan goods with Vanilla Tweak Style ones (Which are all hand-drawn by me). I wanted to give these items a fresh in Vanilla Tweaks Style.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Retextures 53 artisan goods from Cornucopia - Artisan Machines.[/*]
[*]Individual config options for each item.[/*]
[*]A master config option to enable or disable all retextures at once.[/*]
[/list][heading]Retextured Items[/heading]
[b]Oils, Butter & Other Products[/b]

[*]Aloe Gel[/*]

You can:

[*]Enable or disable all retextures using the master toggle.[/*]
[/list]All retextures are enabled by default.
